comments.author: Sophia
comments.body:
lol 4, you get court hat, consul coat, pope staff and gold feet that gives r4+6=r10. go buy / make/ etc stuff and sell in your home nation(its usually easier to barter better price there, not always the capital so shop around a little first) you can also buy stuff (at market rate bout 120%) from home nation and barter a better deal for export.

every time you barter better price and sell/buy without a fail you get accts xp

can also buy the NC +3 trade skills boost 24hrs and proficiency xp boost,
and set the Oxford barter skills on your college skill slots - thats about as fast as your gonna get then its just practice and lil luck

comments.author: Enver
comments.body: Is the discount cap variable or is it fixed? Also, I've noticed inconsistent things when selling. For example, original profit 1M -> three successful haggles capped it to 1.5M -> +50% profit gain. But then, original profit 7M -> three successful haggles capped it to 8.5M -> much less than 50% profit gain. Same account rank both cases. Any explanations for these?
